_note: Scores, weighted score, hard fails and fixes as the judge returned them; each why is abridged by the run from the judge's report.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 1, 5 and 9 strong; 6, 8, 3, 7 and 2 lean on primitive models or dead zones; 4 reads as a chart.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Bay returns on 1, 5, 9 and the tape motif changes state; 3 and 8 sit outside the palette.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, but the deck tapes the 1 million target (not placed in the US by any claim) onto the delayed US bay and asks whether 2027 holds; slide 3 kicker places the chip fab at Gillingham Lane; 'four properties' omits c15's three buildings; 'still unnamed' beyond c6; caption's Fort Bend rests on c13 missing from the first comment; 'It moves data as light' traces to no claim; slide 1 cites c4 unused.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and where are clear; no body, utility, site or step for the reader.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe; 7 repeats the cover; 8 after the reason; 3 and 4 both spend a beat on property.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register; attribution chains and the 'drawn to illustrate' refrain.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Third straight SEC results deck; taped bays, transformer and stakes repeat nos. 56, 59 and 62.

one_sentence_fix: Either quote the release line tying the 1 million 2027 target to the delayed US expansion, or stop taping that target onto the unpowered US bay and stop asking whether 2027 still holds.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat pale horizon band, brown haze, mannequin worker, thin stake row.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera at 0.5 m by the near flagged stake, remove the horizon plane, worker as silhouette.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Modules float in a line across the rack faces; flat grey mid band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Seat the modules in one switch's port row, crop to that switch, one raking aisle light.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Box trailers brightest; navy wall; dead court.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Remove or silhouette the trailers, warm the key, a pool on the court.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Blown white yard, no jamb, mannequin lit flat.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Black jamb along the left 15 percent, pull the apron exposure, worker in partial silhouette.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Reads as a knife; fingers cropped; no tape corner; mid brown floor.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Connector end with fingers toward the lens in frame, across a visible tape corner, floor to near black outside the pool.
